_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Summary Report of Reconciled Passenger and Cargo Manifests
summary: The Summary Report of Reconciled Passenger and Cargo Manifests documents contractors' reconciliation efforts and identifies TWCF cargo, mail, and passenger manifests not captured in DCBS to support billing and audit compliance.
use_relationship:
The Summary Report of Reconciled Passenger and Cargo Manifests documents the contractors' efforts towards achieving contract objectives. The Report is based upon monthly, quarterly, and fiscal year financial reconciliation efforts and activities. The Report identifies Transportation Working Capital Fund (TWCF) cargo, mail, and passenger final manifests not captured within the Department of Defense Distribution Component Billing System (DCBS) after airlift of cargo, mail, and passenger traffic is completed. The Report will be used to identify inefficiencies in transportation of cargo, mail, and passengers, and to provide transportation auditability in support of billing and audit compliance for services provided to airlift users.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Summary Report of Reconciled Passenger and Cargo Manifests shall be in Microsoft Excel format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Summary Report of Reconciled Passenger and Cargo Manifests shall contain the following:

children.title: Number of air inbound, air outbound, and surface manifests completed and successfully transmitted to the DCBS to create financial transactions and billing activity through the DCBS.
Number of reconciled information reports by Combatant Command (COCOM), then by Aerial Port Code (APC) that generated the manifest transaction.
children.content: For each APC the following shall be included:

children.title: Number of attempts to clear cargo, mail, and passenger manifests, to include multiple attempts
Number of shipments cleared for billing
Cargo weight in short tons of shipments reconciled for billing
Total number of passengers cleared for billing
Total number of revenue and non-revenue generating manifests cleared for billing based on classification of mission flown
